project_name: Multi-Tenant SaaS Restaurant Billing POS System
design_language: Flutter Windows Desktop (Material 3 / Fluent Desktop Fusion)
emotional_tone: High-Efficiency Tactical Precision, Ultrafast POS Workflow, Command Center Clarity

window_chrome_header.spec: Top 40px fixed header styled like Windows Desktop app chrome (Fluent/Material 3 hybrid). Contains: App Logo/Tenant Name, Store Selector dropdown, Live Websocket/UrbanPiper Status pill with green/red indicator light, Quick Audio Alert Mute/Unmute toggle, System Clock, and Windows-style action controls (Minimize, Maximize, Close icons).

layout_specs.app_shell: h-screen w-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 font-sans select-none
layout_specs.sidebar_nav: w-64 bg-slate-900 border-r border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between p-3 select-none
layout_specs.pos_menu_section: flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden p-4 space-y-3 bg-slate-950
layout_specs.pos_cart_section: w-[400px] xl:w-[440px] bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between p-4 shadow-2xl

store_login.layout: Centered dark glassmorphic card with Windows acrylic backdrop feel
store_login.components: Tenant select, username, password, quick PIN login option, multi-store login indicator

pos_billing.layout: 2-column split (Menu Grid on Left, Live Cart & Checkout on Right)
pos_billing.search_bar: Sticky top input with shortcut key indicator [Ctrl + /] or [F3], fast category tabs bar
pos_billing.item_card: Compact rectangular cards with sharp crisp borders, price in green mono font, add button with hover lift effect, out of stock overlay option
pos_billing.cart_panel: Header with Order Type selector (Dine-In, Takeaway, Delivery), scrollable item list with +/- count steppers, special instructions notes field, Bill breakdown (Subtotal, Tax/GST 5%, Discount, Rounding, Grand Total), payment action buttons.

integrated_payment_modal.upi_qr_spec: Scannable Razorpay/PhonePe UPI QR code rendered via canvas/SVG with animated scannable line beam, timer countdown, auto-polling payment status bar with simulated success trigger
integrated_payment_modal.cash_calculator: Preset tender buttons (₹100, ₹500, ₹2000, Exact), calculated change due output in large bold green mono typography

online_orders.cards: Kanban style columns (Pending, Preparing, Ready, Dispatched) or dense order list with Swiggy/Zomato branded badges, timer ago tag, auto-accept toggle switch, sound alert audio synth indicator
online_orders.auto_accept: Sticky top bar indicator showing UrbanPiper webhook connection status & auto-accept state

menu_stock_manager.table: Dense data grid with thumbnail, item name, category badge, price, tax rate, fast 1-click In-Stock / Out-of-Stock switch (green/red active glow switch)

thermal_receipt_kot.modal: Interactive 80mm thermal receipt preview and KOT (Kitchen Order Ticket) preview side-by-side with browser print trigger

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, order items, status switches, and totals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='pos-item-add-btn-1', data-testid='checkout-pay-upi-btn', data-testid='stock-toggle-switch-102')

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure complete Flutter Windows desktop visual presentation with top window chrome bar and dense multi-pane grid layout.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown menus or unreadable text overlays.
Always apply data-testid to every interactive component (buttons, inputs, order action buttons, toggles, table rows).
Use JetBrains Mono font or Tailwind font-mono for all currency totals, item counts, order numbers, and timestamp displays.
Include real-time websocket alert simulations (audio toggle sound effect indicator and toast notifications using sonner).
Maintain high-contrast dark theme colors (slate-950 base, slate-900 panels, teal-500 primary accents, emerald-400 monetary values).
